rule: Use only domains from the plan inline array or domain_file; each domain must end in .test; no real users credentials phone numbers or payment details
verification: Check generated addresses Message-ID domains Content-IDs delivery hostnames authentication examples and URL hosts against the normalized domain list

rule: Templates profiles and attachments are packaged locally; read only the selected plan and optional local domain_file as configuration; no SMTP IMAP HTTP or DNS access
verification: Network-denied integration generation

rule: HTML limited to passive tags and inline styling; no scripts events forms frames remote styles external images or data URIs; href values use https and a configured .test domain
verification: Allowlist HTML validation and decoded URL checks

rule: Reviewed PNG JPEG PDF TXT CSV assets and safe generated message/rfc822 email attachments only; no executables macros archives decompression bombs EICAR or exploit payloads
verification: Asset inventory SHA-256 sizes media types dimensions and review metadata

rule: Normal fixtures follow email and MIME standards; stress cases require explicit selection and include_stress: true in the plan; mark each file in batch.astrea-manifest.json
verification: Normal emails have no deliberate format errors; stress entries list their planned errors or stress parameters

rule: Max 10000 messages; max 5242880 serialized bytes per message; max 268435456 serialized bytes per batch
verification: Estimate size before writing and count actual bytes while writing; never complete a partial batch

rule: Normal maximum depth 16; stress maximum depth 64; maximum 1000 MIME parts per email including containers and attached email roots
verification: Count parts and depth without unlimited recursion; check limits while writing

rule: Max total raw headers across entire message 65536 bytes; max raw single header field 16384 bytes; valid lines at most 998 octets
verification: Count header bytes before completing output; stress headers must still fit byte limits

rule: Max 20 attachment parts per message including attached emails; max decoded attachment 2097152 bytes; images at most 2048 by 2048 pixels
verification: Count and decoded size accounting; no expanding container formats

rule: Root depth is 1; each child part adds one level including an attached email root; the depth fixture uses one chain of nested containers
verification: Check manifest part paths and depth against a separate part traversal

rule: Fix seed dates timezone offsets IDs boundaries header order wrapping encodings attachment bytes and file-writing settings
verification: Compare checksums with saved reference files using the same installed Python dependencies generator templates and fixtures

rule: Use reviewed text for each language; record the language Faker actually uses for each field; do not silently replace a body with another language
verification: Reject missing reviewed templates; manifest records fallback fields

rule: Profiles contain named example header sets; no real DKIM or ARC signatures and no promise of delivery
verification: Mark authentication values as synthetic; require reviewed samples before claiming an exact vendor-version match

rule: Derive expected structure and decoded values from fixture rules; calculate checksums and sizes from bytes before writing; do not copy semantic expectations from parser output
verification: Compare files and parser results with independent expectations; keep repeated headers as ordered lists

rule: Generated index-and-ID ASCII filenames; prohibit existing destination symlinks traversal and arbitrary attachment extraction
verification: Test unsafe paths; remove only temporary files created by this run

rule: Content contains no executable code or malware; stress structures may still crash weak parsers; never automatically open generated files
verification: Manifest describes each stress case; run parser tests separately with time and memory limits and no network

rule: A parser may accept a stress email report a format error or reject it because of limits; it must not crash hang or use excessive memory
verification: Check generator output separately from the behavior of the parser being tested

rule: Generate a folder of .eml files and supporting JSON only; Maildir mbox mailbox export import and delivery are out of scope
verification: No mailbox-format output options export/import commands account access or network delivery commands

rule: Plans use <name>.astrea-plan.json; manifests use <name>.astrea-manifest.json; domain lists use <name>.astrea-domains.txt; future config files retain the actual format extension
verification: Check suffix and contents; reject invalid JSON unknown fields and invalid settings; validation requires exactly one manifest in the batch folder

rule: Provide exactly one of domains or domain_file; normalize lowercase and trim whitespace; reject empty lists duplicate domains invalid hostnames and names outside .test
verification: Test inline and file sources; saved plans embed the normalized list so replay needs no external domain file

rule: Periods use unique IDs nonempty titles valid inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates and positive counts; no overlapping dates; threads stay in one period; combined count maximum 10000
verification: Check per-period counts and Date ranges; reject invalid calendars reversed ranges overlaps insufficient coverage and thread-only counts not divisible by three
